en: A black and white postcard depicting a group of people, mostly women and children, sitting outside makeshift shelters constructed from various materials. The scene appears to be a refugee quarter, with visible poverty and basic living conditions. The text at the top of the card is in both French and English, indicating Salonique (the historical name for Thessaloniki), and it describes the area as a refugee quarter. There is also a watermark from www.elia.org.gr.
